note: Both sets correctly read the design-point power coefficient CP = 0.489 with the Design Point condition and a supporting quote. Set A, however, states that same CP fact twice and omits the equally prominent design-point thrust coefficient CT = 0.804 shown in the same annotation box. Set B captures both coefficients with correct bindings and quotes, so it covers the key facts of panel (c) without redundancy.
remarks: Both sets ignore the controller regulation trajectory and power/thrust curve data in panels (a) and (b); those curves are graphical and hard to extract numerically, but qualitative facts (e.g., rated generator power ~15 MW, rated rotor thrust ~2.3 MN) are visible and were not claimed by either set.
